subject: Creativity
title: The Big-C / Little-c Framework
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Big-C / Little-c Framework.

hook.text: Is making a great sandwich creative? Or does creativity require a Picasso-level masterpiece?

buildup.text: Researchers distinguish Big-C creativity (world-changing works) from little-c (everyday problem-solving).

discovery.text: James Kaufman expanded this into the Four C model: mini-c (personal insight), little-c, Pro-c, and Big-C.

twist.text: Big-C gets all the glory. But little-c drives most innovation — small daily improvements compound enormously.

climax.text: Everyone engages in mini-c and little-c daily. Creativity isn't rare — recognizing it is.

punchline.text: You don't need to paint the Sistine Chapel to be creative.

details.summary: The Big-C little-c framework distinguishes between Big-C creativity that changes fields or society and little-c everyday creativity that makes life richer and work more effective. details.whyItMatters: The Big-C/little-c framework rescues creativity from the genius myth. By validating everyday creativity, it encourages creative behavior in everyone and provides a more accurate map of how creativity actually functions in society.
takeaways: Big-C creativity transforms entire fields or societies
Little-c creativity enriches daily life and work at any scale
Both types share the same underlying cognitive processes

faq.question: What is the difference between Big-C and little-c creativity?
faq.answer: Big-C creativity produces works or ideas that change a field: Einstein's relativity, Shakespeare's plays, or the iPhone. Little-c creativity involves the small daily creative acts everyone performs: solving problems, improvising meals, decorating spaces, or finding new approaches at work.

faq.question: Are there levels between Big-C and little-c?
faq.answer: Yes. Researchers have proposed Pro-c for professional-level creativity and mini-c for the personal insights that emerge during learning. The four-level model, mini-c, little-c, Pro-c, and Big-C, captures the full spectrum from personal insight to world-changing innovation.
